verdict.rationale: Shopify's versioning docs describe versioned APIs and libraries released on a predictable quarterly schedule, with older versions retired only after developers have had time to adopt changes, plus a developer changelog to subscribe to. That covers the core of versioned APIs with a deprecation lifecycle. Missing for 10: the specific support window or retirement timeline for each version is not stated in the evidence, the deprecation-notice mechanics are not detailed, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
